name: Zig Zag | 1 1/4 Papers | Orange
description: All Zig-Zag papers have a thin glue line to provide a perfect seal every time. Derived from the sap of the African acacia tree, the natural properties of gum Arabic provide a consistent seal without impacting the taste of your smoke.
